disclaimer: Illustrative investigative check shipped with the prototype. It is not derived from any verified or suppressed incident, and a match is not evidence of fraud. Set thresholds from your own policy before use.
name: Multiple purchases near a procurement threshold within a window
description: Flags several purchase orders to one vendor, each below a configured approval threshold, whose combined value reaches that threshold within a configured window. It indicates the possibility of order splitting, which a reviewer must confirm.

approvalThreshold.rationale: Illustrative placeholder for a single-purchase approval limit. Replace with the limit in your procurement policy.

minPurchases.rationale: Two or more purchases is the minimum that can represent a split.

windowDays.rationale: Illustrative default of one month; align with your purchasing cycle.

eachBelow.description: Each purchase is individually below the approval threshold

support.assumption: Purchases at or above the threshold would already require approval, so they are excluded.

minCount.description: At least the configured number of purchases in one window

support.assumption: A single purchase cannot be a split.

sumAtLeast.description: Their combined value reaches the approval threshold

support.assumption: Splitting matters only if the combined value would have needed approval.

window.description: The purchases fall within the configured window

support.assumption: Purchases far apart in time are less likely to be one requirement.

benignExplanations: Separate, genuinely independent requirements from different departments
Framework or call-off agreement with pre-approved total value
falsePositiveConsiderations: Vendors supplying consumables are routinely ordered from several times a month
Amounts in different currencies are compared without conversion in this prototype
